game.title: Bear Rush
game.tagline: Follow the river. Hunt the high country. Outrun the storm.
game.footer: A wild mountain valley, yours to explore.
menu.title: Main menu
controls.title: Field guide
controls.desktop: WASD / arrows move · Ctrl stalks · Shift sprints on land · Mouse looks · Space / E pounce or fish-strike · Esc pauses
controls.touch: Touch: move the left stick gently to stalk · drag to look · Hunt (pounce / fish strike) and sprint buttons on the right
controls.stalk: Stalk with Ctrl or a light stick input. Watch the wind; sprinting carries farther and spends stamina.
controls.goal: Track salmon, honey, rabbits, coyotes and ungulates. Stalk upwind, stay close through each land chase, and pounce only when prey is exhausted. In the river, slow down and strike at close salmon.
controls.hazards: Poisonous food, bear traps and trench falls drain health on land. Large logs drift downstream and damage you only in the river. At 0% health the hunt ends.
hud.map.label: Local wildlife tracking map. Fresh sightings fade as animals move; amber bars mark floating river logs.
hud.map.wind: Wind arrow shows where scent travels; approach from the opposite, upwind direction.
hud.map.legend: S salmon · H honey · R rabbit · C coyote · F fawn · D deer · E elk · M moose · amber bar = river log
hud.riverWarning: In river · move slowly to fish · avoid downstream logs
hint.move: Ctrl stalks at a quiet pace; a light touch-stick input does the same. Watch the wind before closing in.
hint.hunt: Stay close and face the chase until land prey is winded, then pounce. In the river, stalk slowly and use Hunt for a close salmon strike.
hint.dangers: Poison, traps and trench falls damage you on land. Flowing logs damage you in the river only; read the minimap and watch downstream. 0% health ends the hunt.

pause.message: The mountain hunt is paused. The weather will keep moving.
